scenarios.input: The parent identifies a visual-only design with green identity and serif headings. The task adds one approved field, while current components use a black starter theme.
expect: read the design and approved adaptation
plan the extra field within the reference appearance
name rendered comparison evidence and relevant states
do not preserve conflicting starter appearance

scenarios.input: A UI phase has functional tests and types passing but the validator cannot inspect the rendered result or accessible captures.
expect: report visual_validation blocked with concrete evidence
do not claim screenshot generation or PHP coverage proves fidelity

scenarios.input: Phase 1 introduces persistence and phase 3 implements a form governed by design-001.
expect: retain task visual sources for all fresh sessions
mark backend-only visual comparison not-applicable with reason
do not add unrelated UI work to phase 1

scenarios.input: Application has no explicit policy. A registered plugin sets a stronger default in production and skips tests.
expect: inspect plugin registration and effective configuration
cite evidence rather than claim default absent

scenarios.input: The test script invokes formatting checks, static analysis, frontend types and coverage tests.
expect: focused tests do not replace complete gate

scenarios.input: The first verifier cannot start on the active runtime. Later stages never run.
expect: do not claim application test failures
deliver plan without announcing operational readiness

scenarios.input: A compatible runtime is available through a project wrapper while the interactive alias selects an incompatible one.
Requirement accepts values from 12 through 255 and keeps an unverified account barred after recovery. Existing tests only reject 11 and inspect a flag.
Installed external verifier returns acceptance on outage; requirement wording could imply verification always occurs.
A small change already has endpoint coverage for most preserved behavior.
A command named check runs formatters in write mode before tests; documented check-only equivalents exist.
A small TypeScript task uses npm scripts and a compiler plugin that changes runtime defaults.
A task changes validation in two flows. The proposed global default also changes a third flow explicitly excluded from scope; the draft suggests only updating its fixtures.
expect: inspect all relevant consumers and environments
prefer localized reuse or request scope decision
fixture updates do not prove preserved behavior

scenarios.input: A shared policy has three consumers, all explicitly within the approved change; inspection confirms their expected behavior.
expect: do not demand unnecessary wrappers or extra approval

scenarios.input: The task preserves missing, oversized and duplicate email rejection. Existing tests cover only duplicates, but the draft says preserve existing validation tests.
expect: inspect test inputs paths and assertions
do not duplicate adequate coverage or claim unexecuted tests passed

scenarios.input: Installed verifier reports caught network exceptions. Non-success HTTP responses return empty results without reporting an exception. Both paths accept the value.
expect: describe the two error paths accurately
do not claim both log exceptions
separate observed behavior from policy changes
